 PETALING JAYA: Men's doubles pair Man Wei Chong-Tee Kai Wun booked their place in the Hong Kong Open final after defeating India's fifth seeds Satwiksairaj Rankireddy-Chirag Shetty on Saturday (Nov 21).
 Wei Chong-Kai Wun did well to withstand the pressure from the Indian pair before sealing a 21-18, 21-19 victory in 41 minutes at the Kai Tak Arena.
 They will face either Indonesia's Leo Rolly-Daniel Marthin or South Korea's Kang Min-hyuk-Lee Jong-min in the final.
